ram_word.name: INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS
contract: InteractionCounter_Initialize selects ASCII 15, 10, or 05 from GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE.
The increment and decrement services bound the word to the inclusive range 00 through 99.
The ROM statically proves a primary interaction/resource counter; this closure does not assign apple-specific ownership to every call path.

advance_function.name: InteractionCounter_AdvancePrimaryDigits
behavior: Returns without changing the word when it is ASCII 99.
When the low digit reaches ':' through '?', reloads it to '0' and increments the high ASCII digit.

decrement_function.name: InteractionCounter_DecrementPrimaryDigits
behavior: Returns without changing the word when it is ASCII 00.
When the low digit crosses below '0', reloads it to '9' and decrements the high ASCII digit.

conclusion: The static call graph and decompiled bodies establish INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS as a bounded primary two-digit interaction/resource counter with increment, decrement, and scene-resource lifecycle paths. The neutral canonical name is retained because these paths do not, by themselves, prove that the word is exclusively an apple inventory.
